name: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars - Map Pack 1
summary:
This DLC for the Xbox 360 version of Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars includes five skirmish/multiplayer maps:

Black's Bigger Battle (originally a pre-order bonus map on the PC)
Frontier Fracas (originally a Kane Edition bonus on the PC)
Tiber River Valley (originally a Kane Edition bonus on the PC)
Tiberium Gardens III (originally a Kane Edition bonus on the PC)
Tournament Desert Redux (originally a Kane Edition bonus on the PC)
